content.text: No MFN obligation on our side exists; the only "no less favorably" provision runs in our favour.

input.quote: 1.8 HDI agrees that it shall promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than it promotes HDI's
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-treatment language in the Agreement (§1.8) runs in our favour: HDI must promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than its own catalog titles, at HDI's cost. Nothing obliges The Deerskin Companies to extend HDI terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. The Fees section (§3.1) sets a flat 30% of Net Sales over a monthly threshold with no benchmarking or price-matching mechanic; §7.1 cross-promotion is mutual and "reciprocal and equitable", not an MFN; and §6 exclusivity is a scope restriction rather than a best-terms undertaking (and §6.3 restricts HDI). Consistent with the rule's direction guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is marked compliant and no redline is proposed.
